# Greenhouse data

```{r}
greenhouse.data <- read.csv("https://github.com/jmhulbert/swordfern/raw/refs/heads/main/data/greenhouse/Final-Greenhouse-Data-Combined.csv")
greenhouse.data <- rename(greenhouse.data, "Weight" = "Weight..g.")
greenhouse.data$Total.Fronds <- greenhouse.data$Healthy.Fronds + greenhouse.data$Crispy.Fronds
```

```{r}
greenhouse.data <- greenhouse.data %>% mutate(Proportion.Crispy.Fronds = Crispy.Fronds/Total.Fronds)
```

## Seward Soil Trials

```{r}
seward.data <- greenhouse.data %>% filter(Experiment == "Seward Soil")
```

### Data Visualization

Visualize data for Seward soil trials by comparing weights and number of fronds (total, healthy, and unhealthy) between treatment groups (control - potting mix, sterilized, wild).

#### Frond Health

```{r}
ggplot(seward.data, aes(x = Treatment, y = Proportion.Crispy.Fronds, fill = Treatment)) + 
  geom_violin() + 
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white") + 
  labs(title = "Frond Health (Trials 1 and 2)", y = "Proportion", x = "Soil Treatment") + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))+ 
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1")
```

#### Root Mass

```{r}
ggplot(seward.data, aes(x = Treatment, y = Weight, fill = Treatment)) + 
  geom_violin() +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white") + 
  labs(title = "Root Mass Beween Soil Treatments (Trials 1 and 2)", y = "Mass (g)", x = "Soil Treatment") + 
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title =  element_text(hjust = 0.5)) 
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
ggplot(seward.data, aes(x = Treatment, y = Total.Fronds, fill = Treatment)) +

```

### Analyses

#### Check equality of variances

##### Frond Health

```{r}
leveneTest(Proportion.Crispy.Fronds~as.factor(Treatment), data=seward.data, na.rm = TRUE)
```
There is no evidence for a difference in variability (spread) of crispy fond proportions between groups,, thus satisfying equal variance assumption of anova

##### Root Mass

```{r}
leveneTest(Weight~as.factor(Treatment), data=seward.data, na.rm = TRUE)
```

There is no evidence for a difference in variability (spread) of root mass between groups, thus satisfying equal variance assumption of anova

#### Check for differences in means

##### Frond Health

```{r warning=FALSE}
anova.seward <- oneway.test(Proportion.Crispy.Fronds ~ Treatment, data = seward.data, var.equal = TRUE)
anova.seward

seward.aov <- aov(Proportion.Crispy.Fronds~Treatment, data = seward.data)
summary(seward.aov)

TukeyHSD(seward.aov, conf.level = .95)
```

There was no evidence for a difference in mean proportion crispy fronds between treatments

##### Root Mass

```{r warning=FALSE}
anova.seward <- oneway.test(Weight ~ Treatment, data = seward.data, var.equal = TRUE)
anova.seward

seward.aov <- aov(Weight~Treatment, data = seward.data)
summary(seward.aov)

TukeyHSD(seward.aov, conf.level = .95)
```
There was evidence for an effect of treatment on root mass, F(2, 189) = 3.48, p = .033. Tukey’s post hoc comparisons indicated that mean weight was lower in the Wild treatment than in the Sterilized treatment (mean difference = −3.16g, 95% CI [−6.08g, −0.24g], adjusted p = .031). Neither treatment differed significantly from the Control–Potting Mix group.


```{r}

# Letters based on your Tukey results
letters_df <- data.frame(
  Treatment = c("Sterilized", "Control - Potting Mix", "Wild"),
  letter = c("a", "ab", "b")
)

# Position letters above the highest observation
weight_range <- range(seward.data$Weight, na.rm = TRUE)
letters_df$y <- weight_range[2] + 0.08 * diff(weight_range)

ggplot(seward.data, aes(x = Treatment, y = Weight, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_violin() +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white") +
  geom_text(
    data = letters_df,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = y, label = letter),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Root Mass Between Soil Treatments (Trials 1 and 2)",
    y = "Mass (g)",
    x = "Soil Treatment",
    caption = "Groups sharing a letter do not differ significantly (Tukey HSD, α = 0.05)."
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.12))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

## Inoculation Trials

```{r}
greenhouse.data <- greenhouse.data %>% 
  mutate(Experiment = case_when(
    str_detect(`Trial.x`, "Inoculation") ~ "Inoculation",
    str_detect(`Trial.x`, "Seward") ~ "Seward Soil",
    TRUE ~ NA
  ))

greenhouse.data <- greenhouse.data %>% 
  mutate(Treatment = case_when(
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "W[[:digit:]]") ~ "Wild",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "NONE") ~ "Control",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "BLA") ~ "Control",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "OCC") ~ "Phytophthora occultans",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "OBS") ~ "Phytophthora obscura",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "SYR") ~ "Phytophthora syringae",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "CAM") ~ "Phytophthora cambivora",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "CAC") ~ "Phytophthora cactorum",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "EUR") ~ "Phytophthora clade 7 sp. 1",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "PLU") ~ "Phytophthora plurivora",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "FLE") ~ "Phytophthora clade 7 sp. 1",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "GIN") ~ "Globosporangium intermedium",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "C[[:digit:]]") ~ "Sterilized",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "P[[:digit:]]") ~ "Control - Potting Mix",
    TRUE ~ NA
  ))

greenhouse.data <- greenhouse.data %>%
  mutate(Weight = replace_when(Weight,
    Fern.Number == "EURA062" ~ 5.3,
    Fern.Number == "EURA063" ~ 9.9,
    Fern.Number == "EURA064" ~ 2.72,
    Fern.Number == "SYRB013" ~ 4.15,
    Fern.Number == "SYRB014" ~ 5.39,
    Fern.Number == "SYRB015" ~ 4.56,
    Fern.Number == "SYRB016" ~ 5.75,
    Fern.Number == "SYRB017" ~ 14.75,
    Fern.Number == "SYRB018" ~ 8.76
      )
  )

inoc.data <- greenhouse.data %>% filter(Experiment == "Inoculation")
inoc1 <- inoc.data %>% filter(Trial.x == "Inoculation Trial One")
```

#### Analyses

##### Check data for equality of variances

```{r}
leveneTest(Proportion.Crispy.Fronds ~ as.factor(Treatment), data = inoc1, na.rm = TRUE)
leveneTest(Weight ~ as.factor(Treatment), data = inoc1, na.rm = TRUE)
```
Not enough evidence to reject equality of variances between treatments based on the total number of fronds or dry root weight.

##### ANOVA on inoculation trial 1

```{r}
anova.inoc1 <- oneway.test(`Weight` ~ Treatment, data = inoc1, var.equal = TRUE)
anova.inoc1

inoc1.aov <- aov(Weight~Treatment, data = inoc1)
summary(inoc1.aov)
```
No statistically significant difference in distributions between treatment groups for the total number of fronds and dry root weight for the first inoculation trial (F(9, 60) = 1.1877, p = 0.3235). The true difference in means between treatment groups is likely 0.

##### Cryptogea

```{r}

greenhouse.data$cryptogea <- "No"

greenhouse.data <- greenhouse.data %>% 
  mutate(cryptogea = replace_when(cryptogea,
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "BLAB6") ~ "Yes",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "OCCB2") ~ "Yes",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "EURA5") ~ "Yes",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "SYRA1") ~ "Yes",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "EURB6") ~ "Yes",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "PLUB1") ~ "Yes",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "PLUA4") ~ "Yes",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "EURB5") ~ "Yes",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "W70") ~ "Yes",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "W72") ~ "Yes",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "C72") ~ "Yes",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "C51") ~ "Yes",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "W61") ~ "Yes",
    str_detect(`Fern.Number`, "GINA130") ~ "Yes",
  ))
qqPlot(greenhouse.data$Proportion.Crispy.Fronds)
hist(greenhouse.data$Proportion.Crispy.Fronds)

greenhouse.data %>% shapiro_test(Proportion.Crispy.Fronds)

```

Enough evidence to reject normality from visual inspection of QQ plot and histogram as well as a significant result from the Shapiro-Wilk test.

```{r}
wilcox.test(Proportion.Crispy.Fronds~ cryptogea, data=greenhouse.data)
```
At .05 significance level, within all greenhouse samples, we conclude that the distribution of total number of fronds in samples infected with Phytophthora cryptogea compared to samples not infected with Phytophthora cryptogea are nonidentical populations.
